title: Creamy Pancetta & Mushroom Tagliatelle
summary: Rendered pancetta fat creates a savoury foundation for this creamy mushroom sauce. The key is searing mushrooms properly to develop deep, nutty flavour.

steps.text: Place large pan over medium heat. Add pancetta (no oil needed). Cook 5-7 minutes until fat renders and cubes are crispy. Remove pancetta, leave fat in pan.
Add butter to rendered fat. Turn heat to medium-high. Add mushrooms, cook undisturbed 2-3 minutes for browning, then stir. Add onion, cook 2-3 minutes. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.
Meanwhile, boil pasta in salted water for 1 minute less than package instructions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
(Optional) Pour wine into mushroom pan, let bubble. Lower heat to medium. Pour in cream, simmer gently 2 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan and black pepper. Taste, add salt if needed (pancetta is salty).
Add pasta and crispy pancetta back to sauce. Toss vigorously 1 minute. Add pasta water if too thick. Turn off heat, stir in parsley. Serve immediately.

tips: Guanciale is an amazing substitute for this dish. Do not overcrowd mushrooms - if pan is small, cook in batches. Starchy pasta water is the secret to restaurant-quality pasta. Room temperature cream integrates more smoothly without splitting.
